{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Over the last 6 months, the Young Democratic Socialists of America at Georgia Tech (YDSA GT) has been targeted by an unlawful campaign of intimidation and political repression by Georgia Tech’s administration.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Georgia Tech’s administration’s campaign centers around a politically motivated disciplinary investigation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The existence of the disciplinary investigation directly violates school policy and the U.S. Constitution.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Ariella, a Jewish YDSA Member, says accusing YDSA of being discriminatory for being a place where anti-occupation Jews can grapple with the occupation of Palestinian lands is completely inappropriate.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Office of Student Integrity has played the role of policing certain political views.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Office of Student Integrity is sanctioning YDSA GT for exercising its constitutional rights to freedom of speech and assembly.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Office of Student Integrity is demanding unreasonable punishments that will exhaust YDSA GT’s limited resources.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Office of Student Integrity is demanding unreasonable punishments that will force YDSA GT to betray its own deeply held political values.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Sanctions would force YDSA GT to hold multiple OSI-approved events with organizations “with differing viewpoints”.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Sanctions would place YDSA GT on disciplinary probation.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
